mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate rises by more than 0.25% over the next month, higher discount rates applied to future cash flows reduce the present value of expected corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the following 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or at least equal to the 30-day rolling mean during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in PAYEMS (labor market activity) coinciding with UNRATE below 8% signals tight labor markets, which raises wage growth expectations and supports S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >10% in a month while UNRATE < 8%
regime_hint: Tight labor market with low unemployment
failure_condition: 20-day rolling average of 60-day forward returns is negative or no statistically significant correlation between PAYEMS movement and SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in HOUST (residential construction) above 3% for two consecutive months predicts rising future economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative and HOUST growth is not statistically significant over the period.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) of at least 5% followed by a rebound above 101.61 suggests a supply shock recovery, producing positive 20-day SPX forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls >5% for 2 months then rises above 101.61 in the third month
failure_condition: No significant positive return in the 20-day window after the rebound, or INDPRO does not exceed 101.61.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 218 for three consecutive months, it indicates accelerating inflation expectations, which compresses equity discount rates and yields negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or CPIAUCSL does not sustain the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE below 7% combined with a 15% one-month increase in PAYEMS suggests labor market tightening, which elevates earnings growth forecasts and drives positive 60-day SPX forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 7% and PAYEMS increases by >15% in a month
failure_condition: No significant positive returns over 60 days or no correlation between labor indicators and SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in GDPC1 (GDP) of at least 2% followed by a 4% rebound in the next month predicts a bottoming-out effect, resulting in positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls >2% for a month then rebounds >2% in the following month
failure_condition: No positive 20-day returns after the rebound or GDPC1 does not meet the rebound threshold.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS (retail sales) exceeds 370,000 for two consecutive months during a low-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 215), it signals resilient demand, producing positive 5-day SPX forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative or CPIAUCSL exceeds 215 during the trigger.
